goal: Allow external mining coordinators to validate block templates without maintaining a mirror mempool
Saves memory and bandwidth when verifying miner-selected templates in decentralized protocols
agreement: Strong substantive support with no open objections
Avoids duplicate mempool storage and mirror synchronization for external templates (enirox001)
Verified by running the mining test suite and coinbase checks (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (ismaelsadeeq, pablomartin4btc)
Open suggestion to expose the block total fees (average-gary)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it expands the mining IPC interface so external callers do not need to mirror the node mempool
Reduces IPC bandwidth overhead and round trips for external mining coordinators

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external mining coordinators can efficiently validate custom templates against the node mempool
Unblocks decentralized mining workflows like Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers and weak-block relays
